Since I was working on relocations on s390x, I noticed that other backends had a similar method of using priority to switch between RelocDistance.Near and RelocDistance.Far. I've updated the other backends to be explicit with this for consistancy. Note that s390x is excluded from this PR, as it will be handled by it's own PR.
